title: Wang Gang (美食作家王刚) recipe requirements extraction
method: Subtitles downloaded (yt-dlp, read-only) from Wang Gang's official YouTube channel 'Chef Wang 美食作家王刚' (UCg0m_Ah8P_MQbnn77-vYnYw). zh subtitles = his narration verbatim; en subtitles = channel's official translation. Amounts are his unless g_basis says conv/fan. gap_s = seconds between consecutive wok additions: 'stated' = he says the time; 'est' = our estimate from his wording ('翻炒几下' ≈3 s, 'stir a bit' ≈5 s, 'until fragrant' ≈10–30 s).

conversion_rules.勺 (his small seasoning spoon): only converted when he states it, or as labelled 'conv' using his own equivalences (see spoon list); paste 1勺≈3.3–4 g
conversion_rules.成热 oil temperature: his own mapping: 6成≈180 °C (鱼香肉丝, 风味茄子); 4成≈120 °C, 5成≈150 °C, 8成≈240 °C by the same 30 °C/成 scale (conv)

automation_implications: 润锅/滑锅 + 热锅凉油: pour hot oil out to a return pot; IR oil temperature 120-240 C
离火 (off-heat) additions in ~10 dishes: instant flame cut or wok lift
锅边淋入 edge-pour of 生抽/醋/料酒/黄酒/oil in 17 dishes: nozzle must target wok rim
end-of-stir-fry burst: 3-4 additions within 10-15 s (<=5 s gaps in 30/39 dishes) -> fast dispenser or pre-portioned bowls
碗汁 with starch must be re-stirred right before adding; 水淀粉 dispenser needs agitation
incremental 勾芡 judged visually (麻婆 x3, 脑花豆腐 x4, 酸辣汤 to 20 cm strands) -> vision feedback
tasting/adjust (糖醋排骨, 脑花豆腐) -> fixed gram recipes or salinity sensing
aromatic order/vision gating: 姜蒜 before 葱; chili to dark brown; 豆瓣 low heat until red oil
double deep-fry 150-240 C with skimming -> hot-oil safety
明油 finish (8 dishes) and 泼油 210-240 C over plated dish (水煮肉片, 酸菜鱼)
hand techniques: one-direction marinade mixing 1-2 min, hand-sprinkled salt, multi-coat starch, wet pastes, semi-solid lard
batch-made intermediates: 糖色, 椒盐粉, 刀口辣椒, 红油, 姜葱猪油, 鱼酱油
metered water/stock 30 g - 2 kg at the wok
